title: Varargs and Array-Based Parameters

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study varargs and array-based parameters with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you organize indexed data and avoid incorrect indexes or accidental sharing when copying arrays. In this lesson, focus on variable-length arguments and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: A variable has a declared type and a scope. Initialize local variables before reading them; fields have defined default values, but relying on defaults can hide missing business logic. The important habit is to make the assumptions explicit and use the code example as a small experiment.
